from solution import encode_list


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Example encode_list([1,1,2,3,4,4.3,5,1])==[[2,1],[1,2],[1,3],[1,4],[1,4.3],[1,5],[1,1]]."""
    # runs: 1+1=2 of 1, then 1+1+1+1+1+1=6 singles => 2+1+1+1+1+1+1=8 inputs, 7 runs
    expected = [[2, 1], [1, 2], [1, 3], [1, 4], [1, 4.3], [1, 5], [1, 1]]
    assert encode_list([1, 1, 2, 3, 4, 4.3, 5, 1]) == expected


def test_issue_empty_list():
    """Run-length encoding from an empty list is an empty list."""
    # 0 inputs => 0 runs, 0=0
    expected = []
    assert encode_list([]) == expected


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Run-length encoding of one element is one [1, value] pair."""
    # 1 input => 1 run: 1=1
    expected = [[1, 7]]
    assert encode_list([7]) == expected


def test_issue_all_same_elements():
    """Run-length encoding of identical elements is one [n, value] pair."""
    # 1+1+1+1=4 of 5 => 4 inputs, 1 run
    expected = [[4, 5]]
    assert encode_list([5, 5, 5, 5]) == expected


def test_issue_no_repeats():
    """Run-length encoding with no consecutive duplicates gives count 1 each."""
    # 1+1+1=3 inputs => 3 runs of count 1
    expected = [[1, 1], [1, 2], [1, 3]]
    assert encode_list([1, 2, 3]) == expected


def test_issue_nonconsecutive_repeats_not_merged():
    """Run-length encoding splits same values separated by other values."""
    # 1+1+1=3 inputs => 3 runs, first and last value 1 not merged
    expected = [[1, 1], [1, 2], [1, 1]]
    assert encode_list([1, 2, 1]) == expected


def test_issue_multiple_runs():
    """Run-length encoding reflects each consecutive run with its count."""
    # 1+1+1=3 of 0, 1+1=2 of 1, 1=1 of 2 => 3+2+1=6 inputs, 3 runs
    expected = [[3, 0], [2, 1], [1, 2]]
    assert encode_list([0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 2]) == expected


def test_issue_float_repeats():
    """Run-length encoding groups consecutive equal floats."""
    # 1+1=2 of 4.3, 1=1 of 1.5 => 2+1=3 inputs, 2 runs
    expected = [[2, 4.3], [1, 1.5]]
    assert encode_list([4.3, 4.3, 1.5]) == expected


def test_contract_result_is_list_of_pairs():
    """Reflect the run-length encoding as a list of [count, value] pairs."""
    # 1+1=2 of 1, 1=1 of 2 => 2+1=3 inputs, 2 runs
    expected = [[2, 1], [1, 2]]
    assert encode_list([1, 1, 2]) == expected


def test_contract_counts_sum_to_input_length():
    """Run-length encoding counts cover every input element exactly once."""
    # 1+1+1=3 of 3, 1+1=2 of 4, 1=1 of 5 => 3+2+1=6 inputs
    expected = [[3, 3], [2, 4], [1, 5]]
    assert encode_list([3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5]) == expected


def test_contract_values_order_matches_input():
    """Run-length encoding preserves first-appearance order of runs."""
    # 1=1 of 9, 1+1=2 of 8, 1=1 of 7 => 1+2+1=4 inputs, 3 runs
    expected = [[1, 9], [2, 8], [1, 7]]
    assert encode_list([9, 8, 8, 7]) == expected
